_what: ONE shared correction vocab for BOTH caption normalizers (created 2026-08-03). oliver_format.py (standalone spice path) and spice_normalize.py (the /edit QA path) each auto-load this file and merge it into their tables. EVERY new review-note vocab fix lands HERE — never in only one normalizer (that's how 'legion' and the 08-01 fixes existed in one path and re-shipped on the other).
_rules: proper_words: correctly-cased single tokens the blanket-lowercase must not mangle. misspellings: ASR token -> canonical form (single token each side). phrase_fixes: mishears/phrases -> corrected text (key may be one token or a spaced phrase; value may be multiple words). NEVER add a common noun to proper_words just because it appears in a brand name — that capitalises every generic use. Put the multi-word brand in phrase_fixes instead (see 'gym launch'). Regression found 2026-08-27: standalone 'Gym'/'Launch' here overrode oliver_format.py's exact-sequence rule and produced 4 review notes. never_proper: common nouns that must NEVER appear as standalone proper_words (they capitalise every generic use). Both normalizers hard-fail on load if one shows up.
